title: AEON topic package manifest
description: The manifest.yaml of a library topic package (library/). Packages are curated epistemic scaffolding that accelerates known subjects; they never limit AEON Learn to predefined topics.

id.description: Package identifier; matches the library/<id>/ directory name.

version.description: Package version; an integer or a semantic version string.

domains.description: Knowledge domains the subject spans; each becomes a research and mapping dimension.

canonical_sources.description: Tier 1 and Tier 2 sources any serious treatment of the subject consults. Entries are names or references; the package may detail them further in canonical-sources.yaml.

learning_paths.description: Named learning paths the package supports, for example fundamentals, technical, advanced.

prerequisites.description: ids of packages recommended before this one. Defaults to none.
